title: Test map
description: Which selftests a changed file can affect (product rule 8). Read by bin/test-map.py.

marks.description: Lock scope (owner's rule): per selftest, hermetic (runs fully in its own scratch copy with its own home, temp folders and free ports or stubs, touches no live resource: needs no lock, may run in parallel) or shared (touches the live stack, a fixed port, the real home folder, global config or the live alert log: needs the lock; `why` names it). An unmarked selftest counts as shared; bin/test-map.py check refuses it, and select --json lists in `shared` the selftests that run and are not hermetic: the selected targets, or on a full answer every selftest of the suite (every one when the map cannot be read).

why.description: Required for a shared mark: what live resource the selftest touches.

runner.description: The suite runner; its suite list is the line `for t in <names>; do`.

test_file.description: Where the selftest of a target lives; {name} is the target name.

test_like.description: Globs (matched against the lower-cased path) of files that look like tests: each must be a suite selftest or be listed in not_tests.

not_tests.description: Globs of files that look like tests and are not (fixtures, the runner, this map).

follow.description: Globs of code files; a file that starts with #! is code too. A selftest reaches the files its code names.

data.description: Globs of files read as data (JSON, YAML, text lists). A file that a code or data file names may not sit in a row that adds no target beyond the always gates. An empty or missing list means every file counts.

always.description: Fast gates: targets of every selection.

quick.description: The quick tier the 15-minute watchdog runs (owner decision 2026-11-12): suite names, at least one. The full suite runs at merge and on the final hash.

full.description: Globs of shared contracts: a change selects the full suite. The stack ships it empty (every tracked file has rows instead); a file on it needs no row.

globs.description: Unless the row is a scan row, each glob starts with a literal first path component (a folder or top-level file name without * ? [): bin/test-map.py check refuses any other.

scan.description: true: the targets read every matching file (a folder scan). The row adds targets and does not count as a match.
